affiliates.title: Affiliates
affiliates.description: Create and manage affiliate accounts that promote Rafal with unique codes.

filters.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email, mobile, or code
filters.title: Filter affiliates

empty.title: No affiliates yet
empty.description: Create the first affiliate account to begin the programme.
empty.filteredDescription: Try changing or clearing the current search and status filters.

create.title: Create Affiliate
create.description: Create an active affiliate account. The backend starts credential delivery after a successful save.

edit.title: Edit Affiliate
edit.description: Update profile information. Affiliate code and account status cannot be changed here.

detail.title: Affiliate details
detail.notFoundDescription: This affiliate does not exist or is no longer available.

activity.title: Management activity
activity.description: Profile and account-management changes recorded by the development API.
activity.emptyDescription: Management actions will appear here when they occur.

suspend.title: Suspend Affiliate?
suspend.description: The Affiliate will be suspended and new code use or attribution will be affected. The account and history are preserved, and Affiliate Panel login is not prevented.

reactivate.title: Reactivate Affiliate?
reactivate.description: The Affiliate's active status will be restored for new code use and attribution.

resetPassword.title: Initiate password reset?
resetPassword.description: The backend will queue an SMS credential-reset request. The Affiliate must change the password when required by the authentication flow.

form.codeDescription: Use 4–20 English letters or numbers. Suggestions are not reserved and uniqueness is checked when saving.
form.suggestionError: A code suggestion could not be generated. You can enter a code manually.
form.credentialsNotice: Credentials are delivered by the backend. The dashboard never displays or stores an affiliate password.

validation.mobileInvalid: Enter a valid Saudi mobile number.
validation.codeInvalid: Use 4–20 uppercase English letters or numbers only.
validation.nameTooLong: Full name must be 150 characters or fewer.
validation.emailTooLong: Email must be 254 characters or fewer.
validation.platformTooLong: Platform must be 50 characters or fewer.
validation.usernameTooLong: Username must be 100 characters or fewer.

feedback.created: Affiliate created successfully. Credential delivery has been initiated by the backend.
feedback.createError: The affiliate could not be created. Review the form and try again.
feedback.updateError: The Affiliate profile could not be updated. Review the form and try again.
feedback.suspendError: The Affiliate could not be suspended. Try again.
feedback.reactivateError: The Affiliate could not be reactivated. Try again.
feedback.resetPassword: Password reset initiated. SMS delivery has been queued.
feedback.resetPasswordError: The password reset could not be initiated. Try again.
feedback.statusConflict: The Affiliate status already changed. The current details have been refreshed.

settings.title: Affiliate Programme Settings
settings.description: Configure programme availability and proposed commercial rules.
settings.mockNotice: These settings are saved to the development Mock API. They are not currently enforced by the live storefront, applications, commissions, or payouts.

availability.title: Programme availability
availability.description: Control the stored availability flags for the programme and future applications.

commercial.title: Commercial rules
commercial.description: Store the proposed discount, commission, and payout thresholds without calculating transactions.

legal.title: Legal and terms
legal.description: Reference a static-page slug for the proposed Affiliate terms.

help.programEnabled: Intended to control programme participation and code use once downstream enforcement exists.
help.applicationsEnabled: Stores availability for a future Website application flow that is not implemented yet.
help.customerDiscountPercentage: A value from 0 through 100. Checkout enforcement is not implemented.
help.affiliateCommissionPercentage: A value from 0 through 100. The calculation base is not yet confirmed.
help.minimumPayoutAmount: Enter a positive decimal amount. The production currency is not yet confirmed.
help.termsPageReference: Enter a lowercase, single-segment static-page slug. The page is not verified automatically.

validation.payoutFormat: Enter a decimal amount without a currency symbol.
validation.payoutPositive: Minimum payout amount must be greater than zero.
validation.termsSlug: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and single hyphens only, up to 200 characters.

conflict.title: Settings changed by another administrator
conflict.message: Your draft was preserved. Review the latest saved values below before explicitly retrying your changes.
conflict.reloadError: The latest settings could not be loaded. Your draft is still preserved.

feedback.updateError: The Affiliate programme settings could not be updated. Your draft was preserved.
